payout_quote: Earn up to $675 in your first month! Receive special compensation for your first 8 donations completed within 30 days*. *Compensation amounts are subject to change. New donor compensation is based on completing the stated number of successful donations within 30 days.
steps: Find a Grifols plasma center (run by Biomat USA, PlasmaCare, or Talecris Plasma Resources) on the official grifolsplasma.com site.
Check in and complete the screening and physical exam on your first visit.
Complete your first 8 successful donations within 30 days to earn the special new-donor compensation.
Receive compensation after each donation; per-center pages show the local new-donor total (e.g., $675 Orlando, $720 Houston, $660 Rexburg).
catches: The new-donor total is tied to completing 8 successful donations within 30 days — miss the window or fail a donation and you earn less; amounts are 'subject to change'.
Amounts vary by location (sampled centers: $660–$720 for the first 8).

You must be 18+, weigh at least 110 lbs (50 kg), be in generally good health, bring valid photo ID, proof of address, and Social Security number, and pass the screening and physical exam; not everyone qualifies.
Each donation visit takes about 90-150 minutes; 8 visits in 30 days is a real time commitment.
biggest_catch: The headline total requires completing 8 successful donations within 30 days — a heavy time commitment (each visit 90-150 min) — amounts vary by location, and you must pass medical screening; not everyone qualifies.
eligibility: 18+, at least 110 lbs (50 kg), generally good health; valid photo ID, proof of address, and Social Security number; must pass screening and physical exam. New-donor total requires 8 successful donations within 30 days.
timing: Compensation is paid after each donation; the special new-donor total is based on completing all 8 donations within 30 days.
